scripts.dev: concurrently -n PKGS,API,UI -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:packages" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.dev:packages: npm run build:packages && npm run watch:packages
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @loginhub/schema && npm run build -w @loginhub/database && npm run build -w @loginhub/api-client && npm run build -w @loginhub/middlewares && npm run build -w @loginhub/services
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently -n schema,database,api-client,middlewares,services -c magenta,cyan,yellow,blue,green "npm run build -w @loginhub/schema -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run build -w @loginhub/database -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run build -w @loginhub/api-client -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run build -w @loginhub/middlewares -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run build -w @loginhub/services -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w ui
scripts.docker:deploy: npm run version:bump && docker compose --env-file .env up -d --build
scripts.docker:rebuild: npm run version:bump && docker compose --env-file .env down -v && docker compose --env-file .env up -d --build
